docTypes.deprecationPolicy: journey re-authored or withdrawn with the release that invalidates it; CHANGELOG notice for Stable APIs it teaches

docTypes.versionPolicy: site-release plus the exact tool/package versions the journey pins
docTypes.deprecationPolicy: migration note under docs/migration/ linked from the deprecated how-to at cutover

docTypes.versionPolicy: exact package version per page (public packages at 0.0.1-beta.5); generated pages bind generator and source revision
docTypes.deprecationPolicy: api-stability.md beta notice rule: changelog entry plus at least one beta release of deprecation notice

docTypes.versionPolicy: internal for contributor material; site-release for published explanations
docTypes.deprecationPolicy: internal design material is superseded in place by its owning feature node; published explanations follow the site-release cycle

versioningPolicy.apiReferenceBasis: exact package version documented on the page; a page for an unversioned or private package is an unowned public API page
versioningPolicy.generatedBasis: generator plus source revision; freshness-guarded pages fail validation when the source moves

deprecationPolicy.notice: changelog entry plus at least one beta release of deprecation notice for Stable APIs
deprecationPolicy.cutover: superseded pages redirect or are deleted at the owning node's cutover; no second live authority

navigation.unnavigatedBuiltPages: inventory rows with nav=unnavigated remain built but unreachable from nav/sidebar; DOC9 owns their disposition
